name: Min-jun Choi
bio:
Min-jun's fascination with motorsport began during his mandatory military service, stationed near a small karting track. Weekends spent watching and learning fueled a passion that led him to pursue a degree in Mechanical Engineering at Seoul National University. After graduating, he interned at a local automotive manufacturer before landing a junior position at ProSport Racing, assisting senior engineers with wind tunnel testing.

Now, as a competent wind tunnel operator, Min-jun meticulously plans and executes tests, driven by a desire to optimize aerodynamic performance. He is known for his ability to quickly identify inconsistencies in data and propose solutions. While he's still developing his strategic thinking, his dedication to precision and his eagerness to learn make him a valuable asset to the team. Min-jun is particularly proud of contributing to a minor aerodynamic tweak that improved cornering speeds at Monza last season.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly parted on the side with a slight wave
physical.description: Min-jun is of average height with a lean build and a focused gaze.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with aerodynamic sketches.
Insists on meticulously cleaning the wind tunnel viewing window before each test.
Drinks at least three cups of strong black coffee throughout the day.
